review.notes: Full normalized word-level diff of all 23 extracted PDF pages against the OCR Markdown; code-fence balance check (no fences), heading inventory (all Roman-numeral sections, lettered subsections and appendix match the print; FAQ questions are printed bold run-in headings in the PDF, so their '##' representation is faithful), figure captions (19/19), table captions (3/3) and references (60/60 entries, numbers 1-60 complete) were enumerated on both sides. Pages 4, 7 and 18 were rendered at 120 dpi and physical page 15 at 300 dpi: Table I values (30.2/28.22/24.9/17.9, 27.7/25.44/23.6/17.8) match the print exactly, reference [56] preserves diacritics (Schölkopf, Büchler, João Silvério, Martín-Martín), and 'Yueh hua Wu' in reference [56] matches the print, which itself lacks the hyphen. The p1 author-line superscripts and the arXiv watermark are represented correctly or are not content. The single Markdown escape 'paper\_files' in reference [8]'s URL renders identically to the printed underscore and was deliberately left unchanged.
